sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-9 A in the Volve field, Norwegian North Sea, and is written from general knowledge of the well rather than from a live query of the field data.
No depths, dates, durations, hole sizes, rates or volumes are quoted in this document, because they could not be verified against the source data at the time of writing.
The section-by-section record of hole sizes, casing shoes and drilled intervals for 15/9-F-9 A should be taken from the daily drilling reports and the well summary before this review is relied on.
Any section-level comparison of planned against actual depths should be re-run against the recorded section start and end measured depths for this wellbore.
Total activity time, lost time by tier, and the main lost-time codes for the well have not been quantified here.
A proper lost-time assessment needs the activity codes from the operations log, split into primary and possible lost-time tiers, before any conclusion on non-productive time is drawn.
Before issuing the final end-of-well report, populate the quantitative sections from the field database and re-check every stated figure against its source records.
